versos.texto_bv: E Noé começou a cultivar a terra, e plantou uma vinha.
versos.traducao_literal: E começou Noé, homem do solo, e plantou uma vinha.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0031): Omissão de conteúdo: אִישׁ הָֽאֲדָמָה ('homem do solo/adamah') não foi traduzido. O hebraico descreve Noé como 'אִישׁ הָֽאֲדָמָה' (homem do solo) antes de dizer que plantou a vinha. KJV 'began to be an husbandman' captura esse descritivo. — evidência: termos_originais: אִישׁ (376, HNcmsc) + הָֽאֲדָמָ֑ה (d/127, HTd/Ncfsa) = 'homem do solo'. BV atual omite essa caracterização de Noé.

kjv.texto: And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:

vizinhos.19: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.
vizinhos.21: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.

web.texto: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.

vizinhos.19: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these, the whole earth was populated.
vizinhos.21: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.
